description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 06.09.2021 to 12.09.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
